description.en: Specifies whether to obtain the details of the migration task by using the task ID.

description.zh: 任务名称，如果byVersion为true，该参数表示任务ID。
description.en: The name of the migration task. If the byVersion parameter is set to true, this parameter indicates the ID of the migration task.

descriptions.zh: - 获取迁移任务，您必须有mgw:GetImportJob权限。
descriptions.en: *   To query the information about a migration task, you must have the permission on mgw:GetImportJob.
